"'''If Only I Could Let Go and Cry'''" was a popular [[Music/Legends|single]] released by the all-[[Bith/Legends|Bith]] band [[The Vortices]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the only charting single released by the group, who disbanded not long afterwards, amidst the backdrop of rampant [[Speciesism/Legends|anti-alien sentiment]] promoted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="Blog" />

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}

==Description==
The song, which could also be read in the form of sheet music, was written from the point of view of an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] being who nostalgically recalled moments with a partner while also pondering on the passing of [[Time/Legends|time]]. The song dealt with themes including sadness, nostalgia, the pain of rejection, a relationship breakup and the difficulty of one's expression of emotions.<ref name="MAGL" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CantinaBand-2006SWTrilogyDVDPressKit.png|thumb|The background image used in ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas'']]
The song "If Only I Could Let Go and Cry" was first featured in a segment written by [[Bob Carrau]] for the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by Carrau. In it, [[Wikipedia:sheet music|sheet music]] and its lyrics are provided with a background image<ref name="MAGL" /> of the all-Bith band [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] from the film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in the book is [[Canon|non-canonical]].<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref>

The song was later made canonical in the second part of a series of posts on [[Star Wars Blog|The Official Star Wars Blog]] called [[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]], written by [[Edward M. Erdelac|Ed Erdelac]]. In it, it was revealed that the song was released as a single by the Bith trio The Vortices. The blog post misspelt the song name as "If I Could Only Let Go And Cry."<ref name="Blog" />
